title: New multi-modeling approach can predict rice yield in agrivoltaics
summary: Researchers in Japan have developed a modeling approach to optimize rice yields and electricity generation in agrivoltaic systems. Their findings show that adjusting solar panel tilt angles can improve crop productivity and help meet regulatory yield requirements, with limited economic losses. The post New multi-modeling approach can predict rice yield in agrivoltaics appeared first on pv magazine Global .
